verdicts.screen_vs_qualification: `|R_1| >= 1` is a CANDIDATE SCREEN over runtimes and is a different object from per-runtime qualification. The screen asks whether the study may continue (at least one substrate survives A0); qualification asks whether a given runtime's A0.1 answer is measured or merely adapted. `r_1_a0_1_only` lists runtimes whose A0.1 is PASS (every row measured) and `r_1_a0_1_partial` lists runtimes whose A0.1 is PARTIAL (some rows accepted only on adapter-supplied semantics). A PARTIAL runtime is deliberately NOT in `r_1_a0_1_only`, so a partial result can never be diluted by siblings that passed. Per-runtime eligibility for A1 is declared separately and explicitly by the `Eligible(r)` predicate in `a0/qualification/qualification.json` (see `a0/qualification/QUALIFICATION.md`); the screen can pass while no runtime is Eligible().
